title: bug: heartbeatStop PowerShell reload test omits Test-MoeWrapperReloadDeferred helper
description: Native Windows `cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test` fails src/util/heartbeatStop.test.ts:80: extracted reload body calls Test-MoeWrapperReloadDeferred, but the test injects only Get-MoeSha256Hex/Stop-HeartbeatSidecar/Invoke-MoeDeregister. Error: helper is not recognized. Reproduced in full gate 2026-10-30; unrelated to rail caller attribution.
definitionOfDone: The PowerShell pending-job reload test supplies its required helpers and passes on Windows.
Daemon regression suite passes without suppressing PowerShell coverage.

implementationPlan.description:
Fix both reload fixtures in packages/moe-daemon/src/util/heartbeatStop.test.ts. This is test-only: do not touch scripts/moe-agent.{sh,ps1}.

PowerShell test 'does not reload and lose a pending PowerShell job handle':
- Define `function Test-MoeWrapperReloadDeferred { param($Hash) $false }`. It must return $false (not deferred) so the extracted body goes on to the parse step and the pending-job guard. A $true stub skips the reload and passes vacuously.
- Point $script:MoeWrapperPath at a temp file holding one parseable line (e.g. `$null = 1`), not at the shared scripts/moe-agent.ps1. Its ParseFile then passes whatever a peer's in-progress edit of the real wrapper looks like.
- Add expect(r.output).toContain('MOE_HEARTBEAT_STOP_TIMEOUT'): the pending-handle guard, not a refusal or a deferral, is what kept the handle.

Bash twin 'does not re-exec and lose a pending Bash sidecar handle'. It is vacuous today: MOE_WRAPPER_PATH=unused makes `bash -n` refuse the reload before the HEARTBEAT_PID guard, and the missing wrapper_reload_deferred only passes because the command-not-found exit (127) is inverted by `!`.
- Define `wrapper_reload_deferred() { return 1; }`.
- Set MOE_WRAPPER_PATH to a temp file holding `true`.
- Assert the output contains MOE_HEARTBEAT_STOP_TIMEOUT.

Create the temp files with fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'moe-hb-reload-')) and remove them in a finally or afterEach.

Keep every existing assertion (no BAD_RELOAD / BAD_REEXEC, RETAINED_HANDLE, exit 0), the hasPwsh/hasBash gates, and every other test byte-identical. Error handling: a missing temp file or a stub error fails the test loudly, never by skipping.

Budget: at most +20 net.
implementationPlan.note: Both reload fixtures now stub the deferral check as not-deferred, parse a temp wrapper stand-in, and assert MOE_HEARTBEAT_STOP_TIMEOUT. Net +19. Bash twin passes on Linux snapshot. Dirty peer paths left untouched.

reopenReason: Governor promote under the human's 13:00Z delegation. This is a regression from 5998f871 (commit 9a5426ac). That commit added Test-MoeWrapperReloadDeferred to the moe-agent.ps1 reload body, and heartbeatStop.test.ts never injects it, so native-Windows daemon `npm test` fails for every daemon row. The fix is test-only.

executionContract.intendedBehavior: heartbeatStop.test.ts's PowerShell and Bash reload fixtures stub the reload-deferral check as 'not deferred' and point the wrapper path at a parseable temp file. Both tests then reach and prove the pending-handle guard (MOE_HEARTBEAT_STOP_TIMEOUT), and pass on native Windows and on Linux.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: Extracting the real Test-MoeWrapperReloadDeferred through the AST, as psFunctions does: rejected. It runs git against the shared checkout's wrapper, and while a peer has that file dirty it returns $true (deferred). The test would then pass vacuously, or flip from run to run. A deterministic $false stub plus the guard's own log code proves the intended path.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
- Both reload bodies call the deferral check before parsing: ps1 at about 5991, `-not (Test-MoeWrapperReloadDeferred ...)`; sh at about 6539, `! wrapper_reload_deferred`.
- Both print 'MOE_HEARTBEAT_STOP_TIMEOUT: deferring wrapper reload to preserve the pending helper handle.' when the sidecar handle is still pending.
- The bash twin's MOE_WRAPPER_PATH=unused made `bash -n` refuse before that guard, so the test never reached it.
- A BACKLOG duplicate exists, task-2c3e6170 (commented).
planningNotes.risks:
- On Linux, hasPwsh is true whenever pwsh is installed (e.g. GitHub ubuntu runners), so the PS test runs in Linux CI too. The fix must pass under pwsh on Linux as well.
- Windows temp paths contain single quotes only rarely; reuse the existing replaceAll("'", "''") quoting for any path embedded in the -Command text.
